blogs.title: Beyond Prompting: A Smarter Way to Control AI Art
blogs.description: An introductory guide to Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT), explaining the challenge of guiding large text-to-image models without 'breaking' their original creative abilities. This post will introduce the concept of preserving a model's pre-trained knowledge while adding new, precise controls for users.

blogs.title: The Geometry of Intelligence: Why 'Angles' Matter in AI
blogs.description: A deep dive into the intuition behind the paper. This post explains the concept of hyperspherical energy and why the directions (angles) of neurons, rather than their magnitude, are the key to storing semantic meaning in neural networks. It simplifies the math of orthogonal transformations for a tech-curious audience.

blogs.title: Your Pet, Any Scene: Perfecting Subject-Driven AI Generation
blogs.description: Focusing on the 'Subject-driven generation' aspect of the paper, this post explores how OFT improves upon methods like DreamBooth and LoRA. It explains how to teach an AI a specific subject using only a few images while maintaining high fidelity and stability.

blogs.title: Pixel-Perfect Precision: Mastering Controllable Image Generation
blogs.description: An exploration of 'Controllable generation,' discussing how OFT allows users to guide AI using Canny edges, segmentation maps, and face landmarks. This post will highlight the paper's new 'control consistency metric' and how it outperforms existing tools like ControlNet.

blogs.title: Faster, Leaner, Stronger: Comparing OFT to LoRA
blogs.description: A technical comparison for developers and AI engineers. This post discusses the efficiency of OFT, its faster convergence speeds, its reduced parameter count, and the major advantage of having zero additional computational overhead during inference.
